title: Member Service Commitment — Delay Addition on Approved Class H Preferred Stock Redemptions, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The redemption delay addition makes good the association's own delay in paying an approved Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock redemption request.

## Commitment

| Calendar days from the written request to today | Delay addition |
|---|---|
| More than 45 | 20 percent of the amount named on the request |
| More than the class's retirement processing period (30 calendar days for Class H Preferred Stock) but no more than 45 | 10 percent of the amount named on the request |
| Otherwise | None |

When today is more than 45 calendar days after the written request, the addition is 20 percent of the amount named on the request; when today is more than the retirement processing period but no more than 45 calendar days after it, 10 percent of that amount; otherwise there is no addition.

The written request is the holding's latest approved preferred redemption request, and its date is the date that request was made. The addition is a dollar amount added to the quarter's redemption allowance on the holding, before the allowance is rounded half up to the cent, once, on its final figure.

## Edges (hypothetical request dated 1 July 2026 naming USD 12,000.00)

| Today | Days after the request | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| 31 July 2026 | 30 | None — not more than 30 |
| 1 August 2026 | 31 | USD 1,200.00 (10 percent) |
| 15 August 2026 | 45 | USD 1,200.00 (10 percent) — not more than 45 |
| 16 August 2026 | 46 | USD 2,400.00 (20 percent) |
